rubrics.justification: Accurately describes a good-quality blastocyst consistent with 3AA, including blastocoel, thinned zona, and favorable ICM/TE, while appropriately noting limits of a single static image; slightly cautious/hedged rather than image-specific.

Thoroughly integrates age-related aneuploidy risk, ovarian reserve, male factor diagnosis, semen parameters, endometrial thickness, BMI, lifestyle, and first-cycle status with embryo quality and prognosis.
Reasoning is logical and internally consistent: strong morphology and uterine factors improve prognosis, while age-related aneuploidy tempers expectations; probability estimate is well supported.

Recommendations are well aligned with standard IVF practice and guideline-based care, including elective single embryo transfer for a good-quality blastocyst and avoidance of unproven add-ons in a first-transfer case.

Provides clear practical next steps for transfer management, luteal support, follow-up, and contingency planning after failure; useful and specific, though not highly individualized beyond standard care.
